name: Ecotech Solar
old_description: Founded in 2004, Ecotech Solar began with a clear mission: to bring high-quality solar solutions to Northwest Washington through technical excellence and a genuine commitment to community. Dana Brandt, an electrical engineer with deep roots in renewable energy, started the company from a place of curiosity, care, and determination—values that still guide us today.
about:
Ecotech Solar was founded in 2004 in Bellingham, Washington, by electrical engineer Dana Brandt. The company began with a mission to bring high-quality solar solutions to Northwest Washington through technical excellence and community commitment, and it remains locally owned.

The firm provides design, installation, and long-term maintenance of residential, commercial, and community-scale solar and battery storage systems. Its in-house team handles custom design, permitting, installation, and ongoing support, with a NABCEP-certified senior electrician leading installations. To date, the company has completed over 2,200 installations across Whatcom, Skagit, Island, and surrounding counties.

Ecotech serves homeowners, businesses, nonprofits, tribal communities, libraries, schools, faith-based organizations, and public agencies throughout Northwest Washington. Projects range from single-family homes to community solar initiatives for civic entities.

The company differentiates itself through membership in the Amicus Solar Cooperative, which provides access to top-tier equipment and rigorous installation standards. Ecotech emphasizes long-term customer relationships, offering proactive maintenance and support for the life of each system.
